items.title: How chunk size bounds the delay felt by everything else
items.description: Uses this unit's own verified formula from L3: a concurrent callback's delay is bounded by the size of the current chunk, not the total work (delay = min(chunkMs, totalMs)). Drag chunk size down from 200 (fully unchunked) toward 1 and watch the delay every other pending callback feels drop with it — while the total work itself stays exactly the same.
items.compute: const delayMs = Math.min(params.chunkMs, params.totalMs); return { delayMs };

outputs.label: Delay felt by a concurrent callback
